SELECT   
	Type = 'Work Order',
	WorkOrderCode=WorkOrder.WorkOrderCode,
	aliasname = accounts.aliasname,
	CustCode=WorkOrder.CustCode,
	CustomerName=Accounts.Name,
	Date=WorkOrder.Date,
	UserCode=WorkOrder.UserCode,
	InitiatedBy=WorkOrder.InitiatedBy,
	Address=WorkOrder.Address,
	ContactNo=WorkOrder.ContactNo,
	Email=WorkOrder.Email,
	AvailabilityToVisit=WorkOrder.AvailabilityToVisit,
	Complaint=WorkOrder.Complaint,
	Demand=WorkOrder.Demand,
	Remarks=WorkOrder.Remarks,
	Approved=WorkOrder.Approved,
	ApprovedOn=WorkOrder.ApprovedOn,
	ApprovedBy=WorkOrder.ApprovedBy,
	Posted=WorkOrder.Posted,
	PostedOn=WorkOrder.PostedOn,
	PostedBy=WorkOrder.PostedBy,
	AssessmentDate = (SELECT WOA.Date FROM WorkOrderassessment WOA WHERE WOA.WorkOrderCode=WorkOrder.WorkOrderCode),
	AssessmentUser = (SELECT U.UserName FROM WorkOrderassessment WOA, Users U WHERE WOA.WorkOrderCode=WorkOrder.WorkOrderCode AND WOA.UserCode=U.UserCode),
	AssessedON = (SELECT WOA.AssessedON FROM WorkOrderassessment WOA WHERE WOA.WorkOrderCode=WorkOrder.WorkOrderCode),
	AssessedBy = (SELECT WOA.AssessedBy FROM WorkOrderassessment WOA WHERE WOA.WorkOrderCode=WorkOrder.WorkOrderCode),
	Assessment = (SELECT WOA.Assessment FROM WorkOrderassessment WOA WHERE WOA.WorkOrderCode=WorkOrder.WorkOrderCode),
	ActionProposed = (SELECT WOA.ActionProposed FROM WorkOrderassessment WOA WHERE WOA.WorkOrderCode=WorkOrder.WorkOrderCode),
	AssessmentRemarks = (SELECT WOA.Remarks FROM WorkOrderassessment WOA WHERE WOA.WorkOrderCode=WorkOrder.WorkOrderCode),
	Detail_On = WorkOrderResource.Date,
	Detail_By = (SELECT U.UserName FROM Users U WHERE WorkOrderResource.UserCode=U.UserCode),
	Description = (SELECT R.Name FROM Resource R WHERE R.ResourceCode = WorkOrderResource.ResourceCode),
	Qty = WorkOrderResource.Qty,
	Cost = WorkOrderResource.Cost,
	EstTimeReq = WorkOrderResource.EstTimeReq,
	TimeTaken = WorkOrderResource.TimeTaken,
	Remarks = WorkOrderResource.Remarks,
	SourceGodown=NULL,
	TargetGodown=NULL
FROM  
	customer , 
	WorkOrder
	LEFT OUTER JOIN WorkOrderResource ON (WorkOrder.WorkOrderCode = WorkOrderResource.WorkOrderCode),
	users, 
	accounts  
WHERE 
	WorkOrder.WorkOrderCode = :ai_code AND
	WorkOrder.custcode = customer.custcode and 
	users.usercode = WorkOrder.Usercode and 
	WorkOrder.custcode = accounts.acccode
UNION ALL
